description: The OPEN is refused outright rather than answering with a status: the dataset cannot be reached at all. COBOL has no exception for this - OPEN has a FILE STATUS clause at app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:33 and nothing else - so the refusal must surface as a status, and it surfaces as the same '9' permanent-error convention case09 reaches, giving the identical image '9000'. The two cases are distinct on purpose: case09 is a backend that answered with a response carrying no batch equivalent, this one is a backend that never answered. Both must land on the ELSE MOVE 12 arm at :124 and abend with RETURN-CODE 12, and neither may be allowed to escape as a Java exception, because a program that threw where the COBOL displays and abends would lose the two diagnostic lines the mainframe writes.
